title: Housing Element Environmental Impact Report (State Clearinghouse No. 2021010130) (Housing Element EIR) certified on November 29, 2021, and Addendum No. 1…
text:
[Council File 26-1355; CD 15]
Housing Element Environmental Impact Report (State Clearinghouse No. 2021010130) (Housing Element EIR) certified on November 29, 2021, and Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1), Addendum No. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), and Addendum No. 4 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD4) that the San Pedro Zoning Code Update is within the scope of the project covered by the Housing Element EIR; and that the Housing Element EIR adequately describes the activity for the purposes of California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); and pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15162, 15164 and 15168, and related EIR Findings; amendments to the Environmental Protection Measures; reports from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission and the Mayor; Director of Planning Technical Memo, and Corrected Revised Recommended Actions related to the San Pedro Zoning Code Update; Resolutions to amend the General Plan as follows: a) Amend the General Plan Land Use Element and adopt the San Pedro Community Plan Policy Document Revisions as shown in Exhibit C1; Adopt the General Plan Land Use Map for the San Pedro Community Plan, inclusive of Symbols, Footnotes, and Corresponding Zone and Land Use Nomenclature as shown in Exhibit C3, and the General Plan Land Use Map and Matrix as shown in Exhibit C4; b) Amend the Mobility Plan 2035 to reclassify a selected Street Designation, as shown in Exhibit C6; and c) Amend the Citywide General Plan Framework Element, as shown in Exhibit C5; proposed ordinance to amend the Zoning Map as shown in Exhibit D1; proposed ordinance to repeal the San Pedro Community Plan Implementation Overlay District as shown in Exhibit D6; proposed ordinance to amend the San Pedro Specific Plan as shown in Exhibit D7; proposed Hillside Area Map as shown in Exhibit D2; proposed Targeted Planting Area Map as shown in Exhibit D2; proposed Freeway Adjacency Map as shown in Exhibit D4; proposed Alcohol Permission Area Map shown in Exhibit D5; proposed New Zoning Code Ordinance to amend Chapter 1 and 1A (“New Zoning Code”) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code as shown in Exhibit E1 to add new zoning districts and related regulations to Articles 1-12, and Articles 14 and 15; and proposed amendments to the City’s Zoning Code Maps established in Division 1.5 (Zoning Code Maps) of Article 1 of the New Zoning Code as shown in Exhibit E1; relative to the San Pedro Zoning Code Update, a targeted update to the San Pedro Community Plan. The Proposed Project includes amendments to the General Plan Land Use Map for the San Pedro Community Plan. The Proposed Project would also adopt zoning ordinances to implement the update to the Community Plan, including rezoning all parcels in the San Pedro Community Plan Area (CPA) to transition to the City’s New Zoning Code, repeal of the San Pedro Community Planning Implementation Overlay (CPIO) District boundary, and related amendments to the General Plan, including the Framework Element and Mobility Plan necessary to implement the Plan. The proposed Project will further the City’s broad planning goals, policies, and objectives, including the implementation of key programs from the City’s 2021-2029 Housing Element; the San Pedro CPA is located adjacent to the Port of Los Angeles, the Wilmington-Harbor City Community Plan Area, the Pacific Ocean, and the City of Rancho Palos Verdes. It is generally bounded by: Taper Avenue on the north; John S. Gibson Boulevard, Harbor Boulevard, the West Channel of the Port of Los Angeles, and Cabrillo Beach on the east; the Pacific Ocean on the south; and the western border of Los Angeles with the City of Rancho Palos Verdes; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: City of Los Angeles
Case No. CPC-2025-7122-GPA-ZC-CPIO-SP-CA
